column1: # derivation: §1.5: x NOT IN (...) is NOT (x IN (...)), with §1.4 for the IN
# and §1.1 for the NOT (NOT NULL is NULL). Over x = 1, NULL, 3, NULL, 5: x IN
# (1, NULL) is TRUE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, so NOT IN is FALSE, NULL, NULL,
# NULL, NULL; x IN (1, 3) is TRUE, NULL, TRUE, NULL, FALSE, so NOT IN is
# FALSE, NULL, FALSE, NULL, TRUE. Types: §8.8.
